concern_summary: This concern is dedicated to workspace options selection, enabling users to retrieve and filter active policies and options available for creating new rooms and handling invoices.

This concern focuses on the functionalities associated with Offline Mode, ensuring that actions are appropriately handled when the application is offline, including providing user feedback about the offline status and managing the availability of certain features.
Management of the last accessed workspace policy within the workspace options, ensuring that users can quickly return to their most recently used workspace.
This concern revolves around the functionalities for selecting and managing bank account options within Xero, enabling users to associate bank accounts with specific policy requirements.

This concern revolves around the creation and management of new workspaces, incorporating functionalities for initializing workspaces linked to policy drafts and validating options available for new room creation.
This concern captures functionalities related to creating and managing selection lists of options, including user interactions for enabling or disabling them based on specific conditions.
This concern encompasses functionalities related to managing report fields and options within a workspace, including selection, visibility, and associated user interaction features.
This concern encompasses the management of tax rates within a workspace, including the creation, editing, deletion, and activation or deactivation of tax rates associated with specific policies.
